nodes.text: Hello there! Welcome to the world of Pokemon!
My name is Oak. People call me the Pokemon Professor.
This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokemon!
For some people, Pokemon are pets. Others use them for fights.
Myself... I study Pokemon as a profession.
Now, which Pokemon would you like to start with?
Ah, Bulbasaur! An excellent choice! Take good care of it!
Charmander, the fire type! A spirited choice!
Squirtle! A fine Water-type Pokemon! Treat it well!
Good morning, sweetie! Are you heading out on your adventure?
Make sure to visit Professor Oak's lab before you leave town.
Be careful out there! And don't forget to call!
Hey! I'm Blue, Professor Oak's grandson.
Gramps said he had a Pokemon for me too!
I'll pick the one that's stronger than yours! Smell ya later!
The tall grass is full of wild Pokemon!
You'll need your own Pokemon to safely pass through.
Welcome to Pallet Town!
This is a small and quiet town. Professor Oak's lab is to the north.
Welcome to the Pokemon Center!
Would you like me to heal your Pokemon?
OK, I'll take your Pokemon for a moment...
Your Pokemon are fighting fit! We hope to see you again!
OK! We hope to see you again!
The water routes north of here are beautiful!
If you have a Pokemon that knows Surf, you can explore them!
Misty is so tough! Her Starmie's Water Pulse is devastating!
You'll need some Grass or Electric types to beat her.
Have you been to Nugget Bridge north of here?
They say if you beat all five trainers, you get a prize!
Welcome to the Cerulean Bike Shop!
A bicycle costs 1,000,000 Pokedollars! But if you have a Bike Voucher, it's free!
I'm Officer Jenny! We've had reports of suspicious activity...
Some shady characters in black uniforms were seen near the city. Be careful!
Welcome to the Cerulean City Poke Mart! How can I help you?
I love bikes! But they're so expensive here...
A Team Rocket thug broke into my house and stole my TM!
Please help! I saw him run off toward the north side of town!
We've received reports of a robbery in the city!
A Team Rocket member was seen heading north toward Nugget Bridge. If you spot him, be careful!
Help! I'm stuck as a Pokemon! I was experimenting with my Cell Separation System and merged with a Pokemon!
Please! Run the Cell Separation System on my PC over there!
I'm back to normal! Thank you so much!
Here, take this S.S. Ticket as thanks. It's for the luxury liner in Vermilion City!
That S.S. Ticket will get you aboard the S.S. Anne in Vermilion City. Enjoy!
Welcome to the Nugget Bridge Challenge!
Defeat all five trainers in a row and you'll win a fabulous prize!
This way leads to Vermilion City.
Construction ahead, please be careful!
Congratulations! You beat all the trainers on Nugget Bridge!
Here, take this Nugget as your prize!
By the way... how would you like to join Team Rocket? We're always looking for talented trainers!
What?! You don't want to join?! Then I'll show you what happens to those who refuse Team Rocket!
Grr... You'll regret crossing Team Rocket! We have big plans, and no one can stop us!
